thread:
maria: incident-bot just fired a PagerDuty page for inference-prod (page #PD-87491). customers reporting elevated latency and some 5xxs. seeing spikes from eu-central region. @dave can you take initial?
incident-bot: PagerDuty page PD-87491: HIGH latency - inference-prod - eu-central. Auto-escalation in 5m unless acked. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-87491
pagerbot: claimed by dave (oncall). :rotating_light:
dave: Acked. Jumping on it. pinging logs+autoscaler. If anyone has quick checks, ping now.
maria: thanks. saw kvcache eviction errors in recent deploys, might be related. Also noticed a small deploy 12m ago.
samir: I'm looking at request traces — large batch of long requests hitting the same model variant (v1.3-q4) with unusually large sequence lengths. 95p latency trending 1.2s -> 3.6s. A few 503s from the runtime.
priya: placing a hold on traffic to eu-central via routing rule to us-west fallback for affected customers? We can do a soft reroute for write-heavy customers. Need decision from dave.
dave: do it. Apply route override for inference-prod.routing.weight: set eu-central -> 60%, us-west -> 40% for the next 10m. I'll also add a temporary autoscale bump to the dedicated pool.
kyle: initiated route override. command: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/routing/override -d '{"service":"inference-prod","weights":{"eu-central":60,"us-west":40},"ttl":600}'`
maria: good. Also capturing kvcache metrics: eviction_rate spiked at 14:28 UTC, correlated with the deploy. Suggest we roll back that deploy if the mitigation doesn't land in 15m.
dave: bumping dedicated pool capacity by +2 GPUs now. `kubectl patch pool/dedicated-inference -p '{"spec":{"replicas":6}}'`
samir: tailing runtime logs, seeing repeated "KV cache miss -> refill" messages and some OOM-kernel warnings. Pushing a hotfix to runtime config to lower max_batch_size from 256 -> 128 for eu-central.
priya: applied batch size override via feature-flag for eu-central. feature-flag: inference.max_batch_size=128. Monitor token throughput after change.
incident-bot: PD-87491: acknowledged by dave. Escalation paused.
dave: after the batch-size change and pool bump, 95p latency dropped from 3.6s -> ~900ms within 2m. 503 rate down to 0.5% from 2.8%. Continuing to monitor.
maria: confirmed kvcache eviction rate decreased and refill latencies are lower. Looks like the combination worked.
priya: reroute back? Keep small residual traffic to eu-central to verify stability. I'll move back to 85% eu-central, 15% us-west for 10m.
kyle: route adjustment applied.
samir: running a short synthetic load test against eu-central (seq len 2048) - 95p ~ 980ms. No immediate 5xxs.
dave: good. I'm going to hold the bridge for another 20m, then handoff to the regular oncall in eu region. If things remain stable, we'll keep the runtime config change for the next deploy window; otherwise roll back the recent deploy.
maria: filing a post-incident note: probable root cause = new deploy increased memory pressure causing kvcache churn + batch-size interactions. Action items: revert or patch deploy, add pre-deploy kvcache pressure test, add alert for kvcache_eviction_rate > threshold.
priya: customer impact: brief latency degradation for EU customers, some returned 5xxs. Noting any customer-reported incidents: 3 support tickets opened, one high-touch customer (acme-corp) contacted. I'll coordinate outreach with success.
dave: I'll run a controlled rollback of the deploy if we see another spike. For now, marking PD-87491 resolved when stable. Thanks all.
incident-bot: PD-87491: resolved by dave. Duration: 00:26:29.
maria: quick retrospective note in #postmortems when we close the pager: include timeline, config diffs, and the kvcache metric graphs.
priya: adding customer comms draft to the incident doc.
dave: last check: no 5xxs in the last 5m, heatmap looks good. I'm handing back to eu oncall (kyle) for monitoring. Handoff: I'm available for follow-up.
kyle: taking it. watching for 10m, will escalate if it recurs. :thumbsup:
